visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation scene begins. A round, white blob character wearing a blue shirt and gray pants is jogging on a gray sidewalk. The background consists of a simplified city street with flat-colored buildings under a teal-gray sky. A red car drives by in the background. (2) The camera zooms in on the white character as it holds a gray rectangular device, looking surprised and determined. Sweat beads are visible on its forehead. (3) The character is seen chasing a red car on a two-lane road. The driver, a pink character with glasses, looks back with a bored expression. (4) Close-up on the white character's face, showing intense emotion and sweat, holding the gray object like a precious artifact. (5) The pink character in the red car laughs and gestures dismissively as the car drives away, leaving a white exhaust cloud. (6) The white character is shown indoors, looking touched with large sparkling eyes, then reading a book with a serious expression. (7) A scene transition to a bedroom where the pink character is sleeping. The white character appears outside the window and begins throwing numerous green trash bags onto the sleeping character. (8) The pink character is buried under a massive pile of green bags, appearing shocked and angry. (9) Final promotional frame shows the white character peaking over the trash pile with text details about an event.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One character is a round white creature with pink cheeks wearing a teal shirt. The other is a pink humanoid creature wearing glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Simple 2D city backgrounds with flat-colored buildings, a gray street, and an indoor bedroom with a plain window and bed.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic dance music starts with a fast-paced male vocal singing a jingle. Synthesizer beats are prominent. (2) Music drops out. A high-pitched voice begins speaking rapidly with audible panting sounds. A secondary grumpier male voice responds with short interjections. (3) The tone shifts to a sentimental piano melody. The primary voice becomes slow, soft, and overly emotional, as if reciting poetry. (4) Sudden loud snoring is interrupted by a series of heavy, percussive thud sound effects representing items being dropped. Frantic shouting and screaming follow as the music stops. (5) Fast-paced promotional narration concludes the audio track with a final aggressive exclamation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Conflict -> Emotional Turn -> Subversive Climax -> Promotional Hook
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous animated short story used to engage the audience and promote the 'Two Deerman' (鹿人) 10th-anniversary exhibition in Kaohsiung. It uses a comedic reversal of a 'gratitude' trope to stay memorable.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct textual and vocal announcement of an exhibition with dates and location at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully uses 2D animation and social media editing styles (subtitles, fast cuts) to build a humorous narrative that serves as a promotional vehicle for a physical event.
